name: Jerusalem Post
text: Israel's military is on heightened alert and working closely with US Central Command, citing worries that Iran may launch a surprise strike on Israeli or American targets.

name: Jerusalem Post
text: Pompeo argued that a US naval blockade would push Iran toward escalation and called for strikes on its industrial base, missiles and drones, plus targeting its next leaders.

name: AP
text: At least nine people were reported killed in attacks across Ukraine, as Russia shot down a near-record number of drones.

name: Al Jazeera
text: Norse Atlantic, a Norwegian budget airline, has stopped flying, becoming the latest carrier to collapse under fuel costs tied to the Strait of Hormuz crisis.

name: Ukrainska Pravda
text: Italy's prime minister reportedly reacted angrily in a call with Ukraine's president after Ukraine attacked Russian ships near Libya without notifying its allies beforehand.

name: Reuters
text: A Myanmar military air raid on a village school reportedly killed at least 30 people, according to the opposition.

name: Reuters
text: The medical charity MSF has condemned an Israeli strike that killed two of its staff outside a clinic in Gaza.

name: Mehr News
text: Iran's ground force deputy commander says the Armed Forces are fully ready to defend the borders and that the enemy cannot mount a ground war against Iran.

name: France 24
text: An Israeli strike in Gaza killed two staff members of Doctors Without Borders at a clinic, according to the aid group, while the Israeli military said the pair were Hamas militants.

name: Middle East Eye
text: Iran's president announced that gas pipelines at the South Pars field damaged earlier will be returned to production.

name: Le Monde
text: Ukraine has recently expanded its strikes, hitting Russian ships in the Baltic and Mediterranean seas and even reaching the Libyan port of Benghazi, as it seeks wider support.

name: Ukrainska Pravda
text: Ukrainian politicians and European allies are urging that US envoy Jared Kushner be removed from peace talks after remarks he made about Putin and the war.

name: CNA
text: Saudi Arabia and the Houthis are exchanging strikes that target each other's capital cities.

name: Middle East Eye
text: The Saudi-led coalition reported that the Houthis fired a ballistic missile toward the kingdom's southern region.

name: Kyiv Independent
text: Ukraine reportedly carried out a large drone attack on Moscow Oblast involving 460 drones, prompting flight restrictions at several Moscow-area airports.
